# Contributing

Bug reports and feature requests go through the [issue forms](https://github.com/ddrscott/relay-tty/issues/new/choose), and security problems go through [private reporting](SECURITY.md).

For code, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It is written for coding agents, which do a lot of the work on this repo, but everything in it applies to people too: how to set up, the one command that decides whether a change is ready (`npm run check`), how issues and branches are named, and what a pull request needs. [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) holds the architecture rules that past bugs taught us, such as staying on xterm.js v5 and never resizing a session from a gallery thumbnail.
